name: KiCad Timelapse
description: Record your board as you design it and render a timelapse video.
description_full: Takes snapshots of the open board on a timer (unsaved edits included) and renders them into an MP4 with kicad-cli and ffmpeg. Choose a top, angled or bottom 3D view. Snapshots stay next to your project, so you can render again later at any size or speed.
